# hvrg_view (Resource)

The view records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) display name, unique per owner among live views, and with owner_id the key of the view
- `owner_id` (String) owning organization

### Optional

- `component` (String) Vue single file component rendering the rows
- `data` (String) Tengo body producing the rows the component draws
- `description` (String) what the view shows
- `signal` (String) the signal the data script reads: logs, metrics, traces or records
- `state` (String) draft until it passes the check, active when it renders, erroneous when its last run failed
- `style` (String) CSS of the component
